content: STAGE 1 (goal): orient in the round before committing to one idea. READ: workspace listing of agents/ideation_3 (session.jsonl, progress.jsonl, running.json, stderr.log, opencode.json) and tool catalog. OBSERVED: no repo files in the agent directory; append_progress is available as tools.progress.append_progress; prior rounds all returned math=INCONCLUSIVE for branch/fork/transport/cone/shell/prefix variants of Poincare edge-level geometry. REASONING: earlier rounds exhausted successor-transport, fork-angle, cone, shell/radius, prefix-assignment, tangent-RQ variants, so a new idea should move the coupling into the quantization *codebook partition and rate allocation over the RQ-VAE hierarchy* rather than edge/pair geometry. OPEN: confirm baseline code facts (codebook sizes, epochs/steps) if accessible.

STAGE 2 (final answer produced). Goal: choose one in-scope mechanism not covered by earlier rounds. Read: prior round records (branch-geodesic-rank, fork-angle/transport, cone, shell/radius, GYRO-TARGET-RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, GEOPFX-SID, Lorentz cone, behaviour-anchored charts) - all edge/pair geometry or prefix reweighting, all inconclusive. Observed: no repo file access (external_directory denied), so the proposal is specified against the stated baseline facts only. Reasoning: the unexplored position is the level-1 partition identity itself, not pair geometry. Chosen idea HORO-FLOW-SID: level-1 SID token = horocyclic band of the Poincare Busemann coordinate b_xi(z)=log((1-|z|^2)/|z-xi|^2), where the boundary anchor xi is fitted by a mass-weighted regression onto rtilde_i, the item's rank along the leading out-flow singular mode of the training-only directed transition matrix, and band edges are behaviour-mass quantiles. Behaviour off = rtilde=0, uniform mass, xi fixed at e1, count quantiles; geometry off = linear projection <z,xi> with identity exp map and no boundary constraint; both on = single trained candidate. Cost O(B*d) per step, <3% wall clock at 3000x24 steps over 24556 items, plus one sparse power iteration and one sort per epoch. Full 25-field block was printed in the reply (it exceeded the 4000-char record limit, so it is summarised here). Open: none; no ablation arm is run.
